Class Fx

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.tfx.Fx
public final class Fx extends Object
Factory class providing static methods for creating common effects.

The Fx class serves as the primary entry point for creating effects. It provides convenient factory methods that encapsulate the creation of shaders and their wrapping in Effect instances.

Design Philosophy:

  • Convenience: Simplifies effect creation with sensible defaults
  • Consistency: Provides a uniform API for all effect types
  • Discoverability: All effects are accessible through a single class

Effect Categories:

  • Color Effects: fadeTo, fadeFrom, fadeToFg, fadeFromFg, paint, paintFg, paintBg
  • Text Effects: dissolve, dissolveTo, coalesce, coalesceFrom
  • Motion Effects: sweepIn, sweepOut, slideIn, slideOut
  • Composition: sequence, parallel

Usage Pattern: 

// Simple effect with duration and interpolation
Effect fade = Fx.fadeToFg(Color.CYAN, 2000, Interpolation.SineInOut);

// Effect with custom timer for more control
EffectTimer timer = EffectTimer.fromMs(2000, Interpolation.BounceOut);
Effect fadeCustom = Fx.fadeToFg(Color.CYAN, timer);

// Composed effects
Effect sequence = Fx.sequence(
    Fx.fadeFromFg(Color.BLACK, 500, Interpolation.QuadOut),
    Fx.dissolve(800, Interpolation.Linear)
);

All factory methods return Effect instances that can be further configured using methods like Effect.withFilter(CellFilter), Effect.withColorSpace(TFxColorSpace), and Effect.withPattern(dev.tamboui.tfx.pattern.Pattern).

    • expand

      public static Effect expand(ExpandDirection direction, Style style, EffectTimer timer)
      Creates an expand effect that grows outward from the center in both directions.

      The expand effect fills the area with the specified style (including background color), then reveals the content as it expands. It uses block characters for smooth transitions.

      Parameters:
      direction - The direction of expansion (horizontal or vertical)
      style - The style to apply during expansion (foreground and background colors)
      timer - The effect timer
      Returns:
      An expand effect
